profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Postman
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Engineer with over 10 years in software development and a strong track record in web applications, AI, and DevOps. Passionate about building scalable front-end web applications and robust API layers for customer delightment. Proven ability to leverage AI to increase productivity and streamline complex processes. Adept at building and improving development-to-production transitions through CI/CD pipelines and automation.

Languages:
JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Go, Java, C#, C++, HTML, CSS

Cloud Technologies:
AWS, GCP, OpenStack, VMware

Software/Frameworks: React, Redux, NodeJS, Express, Vite, Flask, FastAPIs, Bootstrap, Tailwind, Webpack, Ruby on Rails, Selenium, Kibana, Grafana, Jira, Backbone, jQuery

Developer Tools: Git, Docker, AWS, GCP, Unix, Agile, Github Actions, Jenkins, Jest, Vitest, Agile, CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Ansible

Databases:
MySQL, MongoDB, Postgres

Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment & Configuration Management:
Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Docker, Jenkins, TeamCity, Bamboo, Vagrant, vRA/vRO

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Acquired by Postman.

Build upon an SDK Generator to produce SDKs in multiple languages from an API specification file such as OpenAPI or Postman Collection.

Created an MCP Server generator to leverage our generated SDKs to connect with AI Agents and Chat.

positions.title: Consultant - DevOps and Cloud Native Apps
positions.description:
Client facing consultant with specialization in DevOps and cloud native app development. Engaged with various large customers, including S&P 500 companies. Worked with clients in financial, telecommunications, healthcare, vacation, and technology sectors.

If I was not building/improving web apps, I was improving the end to end process and time frame of development to production environments, largely through automation.

Engagements included web app development, web app deployments, DevOps automation, CI/CD automation pipelines, and orchestration automation.
